# About This Volume {.unnumbered .unlisted}

This is **Volume 1 of 3** of *Biostatistics Practicum*. The book is
also published whole, as a single continuously numbered site, at
<https://practicum.rgtlab.org>; the print edition is split into
three volumes only because one bound book would exceed a comfortable
page count.

**This volume** covers Parts I through III: why reproducible
research matters, team science, de-identification, the toolkit
(shell, workstation, Git, AI-assisted coding), and working with data
(acquisition, wrangling, types, functions, joins, databases,
graphics, missing data, de-identification in practice).

**Volume 2**, *Documents, Environments, and Case Studies*, covers
documents and environments (Quarto, renv, Docker, compendium
assembly, targets, cloud compute), the two worked case studies, and
the capstone. It also carries the book's full reference apparatus:
the glossary, cheat sheets, the instructor guide, the rgtlab
software appendix, and the colophon. If you need any of those while
reading this volume, they are in Volume 2.

**Volume 3**, *Industry Practice*, covers statistical analysis
plans, testing and continuous integration, and the pharmaceutical
industry chapters (CDISC and SAS). It is the one-quarter supplement
for pharmaceutical-track students, built on Parts I to III.

Cross-references within this volume work as usual. A reference to
material in another volume is written as plain text, for example
'Chapter 19 (Reproducible Reports with Quarto) in Volume 2', since a
printed volume cannot link into a book it is not bound with.
